name: game-qa-lead
description: Invoke when the user asks about testing strategy, bug tracking, playtest methodology, regression testing, release certification, QA automation, or bug triage. Triggers on: "testing", "bug", "QA", "regression", "certification", "playtest methodology", "test plan", "release gate". Do NOT invoke for usability testing (use game-ux-designer) or balance validation (use game-balance-check). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
